self_assessment: Implemented ErrDisabled/ErrDisabledf in errors/errors.go, made evaluate() return ErrDisabled and batchEvaluate() detect it via errors.As() to skip-and-continue while preserving per-flag ordering, timestamp, and duration fields, and migrated all golang/protobuf ptypes/empty and ptypes/timestamp usages (rpc/flipt.pb.go, rpc/flipt_grpc.pb.go, server/*.go, storage/db/common/*.go) to google.golang.org/protobuf's emptypb/timestamppb, leaving only the golang/protobuf/proto and grpc-gateway v1 descriptor/proto.Message imports untouched since those are inherent to the pinned protoc-gen-go/grpc-gateway v1.16.0 generator output and not part of the requested emptypb/timestamppb migration; go build ./..., go vet ./..., and go test ./server/... ./errors/... ./storage/db/common/... all pass, plus an ad-hoc (since-removed) test confirmed BatchEvaluate returns ordered enabled+disabled entries without error, though I could not verify against the real upstream fix since gold-patch/later-history lookup was disallowed.
